title: NestJSRemediationChecklist
description: Comprehensive checklist of maintainability, architecture, and resilience checks for NestJS backend repositories.

checks.requirement: app.enableShutdownHooks() must be invoked before app.listen().
app.useGlobalPipes(new ValidationPipe({ whitelist: true, forbidNonWhitelisted: true, transform: true }))
Helmet middleware must be registered via app.use(helmet()).
Modules and services must not depend on forwardRef(); use domain events or shared sub-modules.
Services must inject repositories via abstract interface Symbol tokens, never directly importing ORM models into controllers.
No explicit 'any' annotations; use typed DTOs, generics, or unknown with narrowing.
Use NestJS Logger service instead of console.log, console.error, or console.warn.
No direct process.env access in service or controller classes; inject ConfigService.
PrismaService or TypeORM DataSource must implement OnModuleDestroy and disconnect pools.
Redis client must call quit() or disconnect() in OnModuleDestroy handler.
